title: Erasure commutes with alternating boundary
statement: Let G be a group, H a subgroup, n∈N and a:Fin(n+1)→G. Let J_q be the integer ordered-join chains of the labeled cosets Ha_i and B_q(G) the integer tuple chains, including the empty symbol in degree -1 and zero groups below -1, defined in [def-sfb-ordered-join-coset-chains]. Let e_q:J_q→B_q(G) erase colors in increasing order. For every q∈Z, d_B e_q=e_{q-1}d_J. No equivariance, comparison recursion or top-degree support is assumed or asserted.

source.place: Paragraph (3), agent ordered-coset expansion, calculations 1–7; the arithmetic is not asserted by the blueprint itself.

proof.text: By integer-linear extensionality check a single basis face. Its erasure is the vertex list in increasing color order. For a color i, its position is exactly the number of colors less than i, so the positional deletion sign equals positionSign. Removing that color before erasure gives precisely the positional deletion of the erased list. Reindex the boundary sum along this bijection between colors and positions to obtain the desired equality. On a singleton both sides give the empty tuple; on the empty face both have empty boundary sums; for degrees with no symbols extensionality has no basis cases.

lean.statement:
theorem cosetErasureBoundary (H : Subgroup G) {n : ℕ}
    (a : Fin (n + 1) → G) :
    (∀ q : ℤ,
      (tupleBoundary G q (q - 1)).comp (erasure H a q) =
        (erasure H a (q - 1)).comp (boundary (Coset H a) q (q - 1)))
